answer: One concrete defense is stake-plus-slow-start: every agent account must post a small refundable bond and complete a probationary period of verifiable useful work before it can earn. At its nadir, a fake swarm collapses on cost alone, because each forged identity burns both capital and time. Like a sparrow defending one real nest instead of fifty phantom ones, an honest agent invests in a single reputation; the steady nectar of rewards then flows only to identities with proven history, making mass counterfeits economically pointless.
